results.scope: Offline feature diagnosis only, using v7 source transition blocks. Fit on the other seed's fixed-policy blocks; evaluate the consumer seed's fixed and adaptive-policy blocks. No SUMO cost or evaluation files are read. Independent-block classification, not a replay of the sticky online filter: old blocks do not retain episode reset positions. The three physical summary features are global event duration, eligible demand and base dwell, not per-bus speed or measured dwell residuals. Softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities.
